headline: Per-role to-dos + notes on Queue cards: each job now has an optional todos[] checklist and a notes string (additive Job fields — no Supabase migration, old records read as [] / ''). New compact summary chip (✓ done/total + note icon) toggles a Reveal panel with an HDS checklist (add/toggle/delete, strikethrough when done, one-click starter tasks) and an on-blur Notes textarea; all mutations flow through the existing updateJob → localStorage + Supabase sync path. Pure helpers in src/todos.ts with table-driven Vitest coverage. Built with HDS + src/ui primitives (MUI is gone — the task's 'MUI v6' framing predated issue #11). Typecheck + lint + all 160 tests + build green; verified renders desktop + 390px and round-trips through localStorage.
